question: Dashain is a famous festival which originated from ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dashain is the longest Hindu festival in Nepal, traditionally celebrated for two weeks with prayers and offerings to Durga, the Universal Mother Goddess.**
 
• The great harvest festival of Nepal, Dashain is a time for family reunions, exchange of gifts and blessings, and elaborate pujas.
 
• **Dashain honours the Goddess Durga, **who was created out of the shakti or energy of all the gods, armed with weapons for each of them.
 
• A large number of animals are officially sacrificed at Hanuman Dhoka during Nawami which is attended by officials, invitees, and visitors.
 
• **The famous festival Fulpatti is also celebrated during these days. It is observed on the 7th day of the Dashain festival.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nepal:**

 
 
• It is a landlocked country whose capital is **Kathmandu **and its currency is the **Nepalese rupee (NPR).**
 
• ** Ram Chandra Poudel** is the current president and** ****Pushpa Kamal Dahal** is the current prime minister of Nepal.
 
• The world's tallest mountain Mount Everest is located in Nepal. Its height is 8,848 meters.
 
• Recently Kajin Sara lake is discovered in the Singarkharka area of Chame in the Manang district of Nepal.
 
• Surya Kiran is a joint military exercise between India and Nepal.
